title: Samsung S22 Android 13 (Xdrip version e1376e-2022.08.03) Blue tooth drop outs
body:
Hi There, 

Navid Fo has kindly been supporting me on X drip FB group but has asked me to post on here as we are running out of ideas. 

I am running Xdrip version e1376e-2022.08.03 on a Samsung S22 ( photos attached for reference) , every night I am getting a drop out which is disconnecting X drip and Android APS.  I have followed the suggestions on the guide below and all settings in x drip are set as per G6 guide (bluetooth & other misc options)

https://navid200.github.io/xDrip/docs/Intermittent?fbclid=IwAR1YFO-i5TLiCsqy9fPYSHXXAtTRAs_ZdBFkDZPEkxs08wNvXd9NLRsNTj0

Here is the link to the FB discussion for reference also. 

https://www.facebook.com/groups/xDripG5/posts/8298621840211238/?comment_id=8298775933529162&reply_comment_id=8311128955627193&notif_id=1669842195940451&notif_t=group_comment_mention

I have attached the screenshots of xdrip version and event logs, so hopefully this will help. 

Does anyone have any ideas how I can stop this drop out ?
